en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square and street lined with historic multi‑story buildings. On the right stands a corner house bearing the sign "Gasthaus zum Schwan," suggesting an inn or guesthouse. At the center-left is a small tree‑covered square with an obelisk‑like monument and other stone elements. A few pedestrians are visible in early 20th‑century attire. The architectural style is Central European, with steep tiled roofs and ornamented facades.
